new_libraries.name: AlashSettings
new_libraries.author: Alash Electronics <alash.electronics@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Settings in EEPROM as one struct: checksum, versions and defaults, wear leveling, power-loss safe writes, migration and delayed autosave. AVR, ESP8266, ESP32.

Examples included, made for classes and kits by Alash Electronics.

new_libraries.author: Alash Electronics <alash.electronics@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Type K thermocouple library for MAX6675 and MAX31855 modules: temperature up to 1350 C, cold junction, open and short detection, clear messages. No dependencies.
new_libraries.paragraph: Reads a type K thermocouple through a MAX6675 (0 to 1024 C) or MAX31855 (-200 to 1350 C) SPI module with one object: AlashThermocouple tc(AlashThermocouple::MAX6675, cs, clk, miso); tc.temperature(). Software SPI on any pins or hardware SPI, internal cold junction temperature of the MAX31855, detection of a broken thermocouple and of a short to GND or VCC, frame plausibility check, caching to the chip conversion time, offset. Explains wiring problems in Russian, Kazakh or English. Needs only the built-in SPI library. Works on Arduino AVR, ESP32, ESP8266. Examples included, made for classes and kits by Alash Electronics.

new_libraries.name: AlashTimer
new_libraries.author: Alash Electronics <alash.electronics@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Easy non-blocking timers without delay(): every(), once, stopwatch and blinking LED patterns. Safe over millis() overflow, no dependencies.
new_libraries.paragraph: Replaces delay() and millis() boilerplate: AlashTimer t(1000); if (t.ready()) ... runs code every second without stopping the program, once after a delay, with pause and resume, in milliseconds or microseconds. AlashBlinker blinks an LED with blink(), flash(3) or a custom pattern such as SOS. Works on Arduino AVR, ESP32, ESP8266 and other boards. Examples included, made for classes and kits by Alash Electronics.

new_libraries.name: AlashTM1637
new_libraries.author: Alash Electronics <alash.electronics@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Easy TM1637 4- and 6-digit 7-segment display library: numbers, decimals, clock with colon, text, scrolling, brightness. No dependencies.
new_libraries.paragraph: Drives the popular TM1637 4-digit and 6-digit display modules with showNumber(), showFloat(), showTime(), showTimeHMS() and showText(): right-aligned numbers with minus sign, decimal point on the right digit, blinking colon, scrolling text and brightness. The odd digit order of 6-digit modules is handled for you and can be changed with setDigitMap(). begin() reports a missing display and explains wiring problems in Russian, Kazakh or English. Works on any two pins, no dependencies.

new_libraries.name: AlashWeb
new_libraries.author: Alash Electronics <alash.electronics@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Easy web control panel for ESP32 and ESP8266: buttons, switches, sliders, live values with a chart on a page you open from a phone. No AsyncWebServer.
new_libraries.paragraph: Builds a mobile-friendly control page in a few lines: web.addSwitch(), addButton(), addSlider(), addValue() with an optional live chart and addText(); the page shows up at the board address, updates every second and sends commands back to your functions. Optional password, dark theme, Cyrillic labels, and clear tips in Russian, Kazakh or English when the page does not open. Needs only the built-in WebServer, no AsyncWebServer or SPIFFS. Examples included, made for classes and kits by Alash Electronics.

new_libraries.name: AlashWiFi
new_libraries.author: Alash Electronics <alash.electronics@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Easy Wi-Fi library for ESP32 and ESP8266: clear error reasons, auto-reconnect, saved network and a phone setup portal like WiFiManager.
new_libraries.paragraph: Connects an ESP32 or ESP8266 to Wi-Fi with wifi.begin(name, password) and tells why it failed (network not found, wrong password, 5 GHz network, weak signal) in Russian, Kazakh or English. wifi.autoConnect() opens a setup page on your phone the first time, saves the network and reconnects by itself afterwards, with growing retry delays. Includes a network scanner and a diagnose() helper. Needs only the built-in WiFi, WebServer and DNSServer libraries. Examples included, made for classes and kits by Alash Electronics.

library.name: AsyncConfigPortal
library.author: Peter Soos
library.sentence: Reusable modular web configuration portal for ESP32 and ESP8266.
library.paragraph: HTTP digest auth, a dynamic menu, a system Status page, and an Other page (OTA with firmware-marker validation, restart, backup, password change), plus a composition API (addPage / addJsonEndpoint / addPostHandler) for project-specific pages. Ships an optional, opt-in network-configuration module.

library.name: BLE Serial - NUS
library.author: Urs Utzinger
library.sentence: Library creating a Nordic UART Service on a BLE device. Server mode.
library.paragraph: Provides Serial over BLE. This is not a serial port emulation but a Nordic UART Service (NUS) implementation using the NimBLE-Arduino library.
